blends.name: Not a race... Shingland - level 300 blend
blends.desc:
In celebration of the Taco venue Shingland reaching level 300, and unlocking Acryptia for the entire community!

You will need the following ingredients to complete the blend:
* 1 Not a race... Shingland - level 300 tee - Sticker (torso slot)
* 1 rainbow metal meeple (a blend of all 10 common wooden meeple colors)
   https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends?category=Meeples
	
Blend: https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends?category=Collaborations
* Add the ingredients required
* Click “blend”

blends.name: Acryptia - ...and all I got was this shirt
blends.desc:
You will need the following ingredients to complete the blend:
* 1 face slot sticker
* 1 torso slot sticker
* 1 rainbow metal meeple (a blend of all 10 common wooden meeple colors)
   https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends?category=Meeples
	
Blend: https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends?category=Collaborations
* Select the torso blend that matches your tee shirt
* Add the ingredients required
* Click “blend”
* ***For this Acryptia Season 1 blend, it doesn’t matter which face you add, the only guarantee is that your tee shirt will be the same.*** If you don’t like the idea of using a face sticker of your favorite Taco Team and not getting a meeple with their face on it, then hold onto that sticker, there will be additional Meeple Fashion blends from the Taco Universe coming soon!

blends.desc: A rainbow metal meeple is a blend of all 10 common wooden meeple templates. It is sometimes used in blends, which means that when added, you're not sure which color of meeple expresses themselves.

blends.name: Tulip - Window 3 C
blends.desc:
As a stained glass artisan, you want your Meeple Assistant to create a rare Black and Red Tulip with the sun rising behind it...
You remember that to create a double-recessive window, if you combine AB + AB, you have a 25% chance of getting C, but in this case, you've been working with your Meeple Assistant for a while and you're fairly positive that you can create a rare Window 3 C

**Drop Rates:**
* 100% chance of a rare Tulip - Window 3 C

NFTulip Mania is about the cross-breeding of varieties of flowers inspired by Gregor Johann Mendel's work on genetics plus the historic Tulip Mania of 1637.

blends.name: Burnouts Violet Window
blends.desc:
Thanks for volunteering at **Burnouts Elysium**! Your brigade work helps us continue to level up!

This is a collaboration between Game Elements and Burnouts Elysium (a Taco venue). You can keep the NFT (which is part of the *gameelements* collection), or trade it to become part of the *burnoutelys* collection.

You can keep the NFT as is, or add some stained glass to turn it into a full stained glass window! By blending various Game Elements (NFTs), you'll have a fancy window in no time! Here's what you need to make a full stained glass window:
* **1 = Burnouts Violet Window - Pattern**
* **1 = Clouded Marble Glass - Black** (these drop from packs or you can blend 5 Cathedral Glass - Black to create one: (https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends/blend.nefty/19087)
* **1 = Clouded Marble Glass - Purple** (these drop from packs or you can blend 5 Cathedral Glass - Purple to create one: (https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends/blend.nefty/19085)
* **1 = Cathedral Glass - Green** (these drop from packs or you can blend 5 glass NFTs of any type to create one: (https://neftyblocks.com/c/gameelements/blends/blend.nefty/19292)
* **3 = glass NFTs**, anything that you got in a glass pack will work

For more info on the collaboration, or if you have any questions about blending, join the **Burnouts Elysium** discord: https://discord.gg/69XF7e9HFJ

You can trade this NFT for the same mint number in the QHop collection. 
1. Set up a trade with the WAX wallet: <<fgzk4.c.wam>> and select the same mint. 
2. Send the trade.
3. On the Burnouts Elysium discord https://discord.gg/69XF7e9HFJ, send a message to @Burnouts Elysium on the #main-chat channel with a copy of the txn, and the trade will be accepted!

blends.name: Recycling - Cathedral Glass Clear 1
blends.desc:
**Reduce. Reuse. Recycle.**
Can't find the Cathedral Glass Clear 1 you're looking for on the market, and you don't have time for opening new packs of glass? Well now you can recycle your unused glass for the stained glass you're looking for.

**How it works**
Add 5 glass of any template, and blend them together. You're going to get a black sheet of clear glass.

**Drop Rates:**
100% chance of an common Cathedral Glass - Clear 1
